title: OIR investigation
description: A targeted question that separates specific hypotheses. An investigation that cannot name the pair it separates is a topic search and is rejected at intake.

question.description: A discriminating question with a locatable answer, not a topic.

separates.description: Hypothesis pairs this investigation can distinguish. Empty fails the admission test.

expected_if.description: Written BEFORE retrieval. Committing to what would surprise you is the anti-confirmation device.

first.description: What the world looks like if the first hypothesis of the pair holds.

second.description: What it looks like if the second holds.

rank_score.description: Ordinal heuristic output: separable pairs x obtainability / cost. NOT a probability and never reported as one.

null_result.description: True when the investigation ran and found nothing. A finding, not a failure; prevents repeat searches and stops 'not found' becoming 'does not exist'.
